sources.label: IESNA RP-5 — Recommended Practice for Daylighting
sources.description: Guidelines for daylighting design including daylight factor calculations, window orientation, shading strategies, and integration with artificial lighting.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule VII — Natural Lighting Requirements
sources.description: Minimum window area (10% of floor area) for natural lighting in habitable rooms. Fenestration standards by orientation.

sources.label: ASHRAE 90.1 — Daylighting Controls and Automatic Shading Requirements
sources.description: Requires daylight-responsive lighting controls in spaces with adequate daylight. References daylight factor and glare analysis standards.
